title: "A Miracle!" Knicks Pull Off Biggest Comeback Game In NBA Finals History
text:
If the ratings have been phenomenal for the NBA Finals so far, the numbers for this Game 4 might defy superlatives. Or maybe, to take a cue from ABC play-by-play announcer Mike Breen, they might just be miraculous. “A miracle comeback!” shouted Breen after time ran out.

Or maybe, to take a cue from ABC play-by-play announcer Mike Breen, they might just be miraculous.
“A miracle comeback! ” shouted Breen after time ran out.
“Knicks pull off largest comeback in NBA Finals history! ”Late-Night Hosts Dunk On Trump For Falling Asleep During NBA Finals & “Jinxing” New York Knickspulled off the greatest comeback game in NBA Finals history at Madison Square Garden to take a 3-1 game lead over the San Antonio Spurs in the series.
What’s more, should the Knicks win the series, it would mark a potentially even more improbable comeback: The first NBA Championship in 53 years for the Mecca of Basketball. The previous one-game comeback record was 24 points, set by the Boston Celtics in the 2008 NBA Finals against the Los Angeles Lakers. Tonight’s last-second play capped a comeback began with New York’s floor captain Jalen Brunson bringing the ball up the court with his team trailing by one point.
Brunson, the Knicks’ leading scorer, pulled up with about 5 seconds left to take a 3-point shot which hit the front of the rim and careened off. From nowhere came Knicks’ forward OG Anunoby flying past San Antonio’s 7’5″ center Victor Wembanyama to tip the ball in with just 1.2 seconds left. How good was it?
In New York where — much like Los Angeles — fans start heading for the exits with a few minutes to go, the crowd lingered after the game, with ABC cutting to shots of a shocked Jerry Seinfeld looking at the scoreboard, Taylor Swift, Mariska Hargitay and the Haim Sisters jumping for joy together and Larry David smiling. By the time ESPN cut to inside the NBA 10-15 minutes later, the bowl at the Garden was still half full of Knicks fans savoring the team’s greatest win in the past half-century.
